item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.24
item.description: - New look: ConformTXT's icon is now an ivory keycap with ⌘V in ink. On macOS 26 and later it's a Liquid Glass icon, with the Mac's dark, clear and tinted looks; earlier macOS versions get the same design as a flat icon. - The wordmark's ".txt" sits in an ink box with ivory text (ivory with ink text in dark mode). - Switches, links and buttons now use your Mac's accent color. A matched paste shows a green dot in History, and the menu bar icon flashes as a tiny ivory-and-ink app icon.
